design.thresholds: p_paper uses 0.5 times the smaller ++ axis maximum. Other fits use 0.5 times the smallest maximum across four half-axes, within each model/pair.
design.pairing: Same ordered names, angles, prompt checksums, anchor token IDs and extraction layers verified within each trained/control comparison. Direction vectors recomputed for each checkpoint. Differences are computed per pair before taking family medians. The three-shuffle comparison averages the three matched seed values for each pair.
design.axis2_sign: Shared-threshold p averaged over either sign of axis 1 within each pair. Axis 2 is the non-English language or code direction in every corresponding family pair. The sign gap is computed before taking medians.
design.shuffle: Each transformer block's 2D weight matrices are permuted entrywise within each matrix. The tokenizer, embeddings, and 1D normalization weights are preserved. Directions and anchor activations are re-extracted for each seed. Pythia step0 is a separate initialization control.
design.cosine_sensitivity: The prespecified panel is fixed across models. both_abs_cos_lt_point1 restricts to pairs with absolute pre-orthogonalization direction cosine below 0.1 in all checkpoints in the contrast.
design.inference: Descriptive fixed-panel medians. Pairs share directions and anchors; this summary treats neither pairs nor the three seeds as independent replicates of training.
